text:
laura_finance: BrightLabs opened a dispute on Feb invoice, claiming a large spike from /v1/streams on 2026-02-15. They want billing paused while we investigate.
tom_support: Customer reports ~2.1M tokens that day vs ~200k normal. They've provided some request_ids.
lina_runtime: quick check: we did a small deploy at ~03:12 UTC that changed stream ACK persist keys briefly. Canary showed duplicate emits.
rina_runtime: log snippet:
```
[2026-02-15T03:12:11Z] req=rx_x1 emit tokens=1342 seq=7
[2026-02-15T03:12:12Z] session_disconnect
[2026-02-15T03:12:13Z] session_resume emit tokens=1342 seq=7
```
jay_sre: We rolled the deploy back at 03:14 UTC when smoke failed. Looks like a ~2 minute window of altered dedupe keys.
rina_runtime: Discovery plan: readonly query to find duplicated (request_id,event_seq) in 03:10-03:16 UTC, then produce correction rows. Example SQL: SELECT account_id, request_id, event_seq, COUNT(*) FROM metering.stream_events WHERE emitted_at BETWEEN '2026-02-15T03:10:00Z' AND '2026-02-15T03:16:00Z' GROUP BY account_id, request_id, event_seq HAVING COUNT(*)>1;
rin a_runtime: I'll run readonly now and share counts.
laura_finance: If this is isolated to BrightLabs, finance can approve a provisional credit up to $15k pending verification. Need a billing ticket and ops lead signoff.
olga_prodops: Agreed. I'll coordinate comms.
billing-bot: Created billing ticket CB-3412 linked to INV-2026-02-BL.
trina_runtime: Readonly result: BrightLabs duplicate_tokens=1,512,420. Estimated USD at their rate = $14,760 (pre-rounding). I'll produce correction table with checksums.
laura_finance: Approving provisional credit $15,000 pending audit artifacts (query output, correction table checksum, token->USD calc).
jay_sre: Scheduling brief postmortem with runtime + infra.
rina_runtime: Starting safe correction write to staging billing table under maintenance lock. ETA ~2.5 hours including verification.
tom_support: I've told BrightLabs we'll provisionally credit while we verify; they acknowledged.
laura_finance: Keep this thread updated and attach audit files when done.
